rv.q: A Round-Heeled Woman is a hard show to really dislike, but after the initial come-on there is way more schmaltz than sex.
A must-see show, with a feel-good factor which blows winds of hope into your sails.

cn.t: Critics split on this adaptation of Jane Juska's memoir, with some finding it perky but clumsy in execution, while others appreciate Gless's performance and the daring premise of a 66-year-old woman's sexual reawakening after decades of celibacy.
